rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday verb for producing copies with a printer.

example.english: I want to print a few more copies of this document.
example.traditional: 我想印多幾份呢份文件。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 jan3 do1 gei2 fan6 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fingerprint, including a police-found print.

example.english: The police found your print on the door handle.
example.traditional: 警察喺門柄上面搵到你嘅指紋。
example.jyutping: ging2 caat3 hai2 mun4 beng2 soeng6 min6 wan2 dou2 nei5 ge3 zi2 man4

rows.note: Use this all-purpose noun when referring to the letters or text of a document, especially its readability or size.

example.english: The print on the paper is too small for me to read.
example.traditional: 張紙啲字太細，我睇唔清。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 zi2 di1 zi6 taai3 sai3 ngo5 tai2 m4 cing1

rows.note: Use this for clear, separate block-style handwriting rather than connected cursive writing.

example.english: Please print clearly on this form; don't write in cursive.
example.traditional: 請用正楷填呢份表，唔好草書。
example.jyutping: cing2 jung6 zing3 kaai2 tin4 ni1 fan6 biu2 m4 hou2 cou2 syu1

rows.note: Use this for a visible mark or impression left on a surface.

example.english: The bottom of the cup left a print on the table.
example.traditional: 杯底喺張枱上留低咗一個印。
example.jyutping: bui1 dai2 hai2 zoeng1 toi2 soeng6 lau4 dai1 zo2 jat1 go3 jan3

rows.note: Use this when telling someone to write clearly in block letters rather than cursive.

example.english: Please print in block letters, not cursive.
example.traditional: 請你用正楷寫，唔好連筆。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 jung6 zing3 kaai2 se2 m4 hou2 lin4 bat1

rows.note: Use this for publishing a book or other substantial printed work.

example.english: They plan to print this book next month.
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 haa6 go3 jyut6 ceot1 baan2

rows.note: Use this for publishing material such as a report or rumour in a newspaper or magazine.

example.english: The newspaper will print this report.
example.jyutping: bou3 zi2 wui5 hon1 dang1 ni1 pin1 bou3 dou6
